description.value: Caveman Cafe bills itself as the 'King of Keto' — a health-focused restaurant and bakery serving globally-inspired whole-food meals that are fully customizable for keto, paleo, vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets. The menu runs from butter chicken and burritos to grassfed steaks and raw-vegan desserts, all made without refined sugar or processed ingredients. The operation also does large-scale off-site catering and has a community record of supplying healthy meals to social-service organizations across Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 72m; stands (4 spaces) at 76m; stands at 98m; stands (3 spaces) at 100m. Total: 10 spaces.
